newsitem.title: USA: Garden sees Q4 same-store sales up 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Garden sees Q4 same-store sales up 0.5 pct.

text.p: Garden Ridge Corp said Thursday it expects a 0.5 percent increase in fiscal fourth quarter same-store sales, which is slightly less than expected due to extremely inclement weather in January that temporarily closed a majority of the company's comparable stores.
Garden Ridge said it believes resources added in management and staff during the fourth quarter will position it for positive comparable-store sales for fiscal 1998.
Garden Ridge also said its board had approved the opening of four new stores during fiscal 1998, which would increase its store count to 22.

Two stores will open in Atlanta in the first quarter of fiscal 1998, a third Atlanta store will open in the second quarter, and a store in Lewisville, Texas, near Dallas/Ft. Worth is planned for the third quarter, the company said.
The company said it will be testing the Lewisville store with about 105,000 square feet of selling space with the same product assortment as current stores with 125,000 square feet of selling space.
Garden Ridge said it plans to grow its store count at a 25-30 percent pace in the next fiscal year.
